subject: Supplier activation: invoice routing, PO terms, and onboarding documents
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Samir Singh <samir@aurora-systems.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier activation: invoice routing, PO terms, and onboarding documents

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to start the supplier activation so procurement and accounting can issue POs and route invoices. To speed things along, can you please provide the following items by end of week? I attached our vendor onboarding form for your convenience.

What we need from Aurora Systems (please attach directly to replies):
- Completed vendor onboarding form (Vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx) — required fields: legal name, remit-to address, EIN, primary billing contact.
- Completed W-9 (or local tax form) as PDF (file name: W9_Aurora.pdf).
- A copy of your standard MSA or reseller agreement (we can review redlines) — PDF preferred.
- Bank details or payment instructions (ACH template or remittance advice).
- Primary account manager and escalation contact (name, title, email, phone).

What Redwood will provide / next steps from our side:
- We'll create an internal vendor record and route PO requests to the email you specify.
- Typical PO cadence: our systems issue a PO after SOW acceptance (we'll confirm timing).
- Accounting note: net-45 terms by default; if you need net-30 or different, please flag it now and include supporting justification.
- We'll share a DocuSign link for MSA acceptance if redlines are agreed.

Attachments included: Vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx

If you prefer a quick kickoff call to walk through the form, I can loop Aditya (finance lead) and Vanessa (ops).

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | (415) 555-0124

---
Note: please send attachments as PDFs/XLSX. For banking data, if you prefer a secure portal, indicate that in the reply and we'll share a secure upload link.

From: Samir Singh <samir@aurora-systems.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@aurora-systems.com
Date: Wed, 12 Apr 2028 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier activation: invoice routing, PO terms, and onboarding documents

Hi Olga —

Appreciate the checklist — attached are the items we have prepared: W9_Aurora.pdf and our completed onboarding form. I've asked our legal team to send the standard MSA; they may return a redline.

Attachments: W9_Aurora.pdf (pdf), Vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx (xlsx)

Quick questions:
1) We normally require net-30. Is there flexibility to accept net-30 for first-year engagements?
2) For PO delivery, do you prefer PO@redwood.com or a vendor-specific mailbox? Our AP system needs a static address for automated routing.

If it helps, I can schedule a 30-minute call Thursday morning PST with our accounting lead to confirm remittance details.

Best,
Samir Singh
Head of Partnerships
Aurora Systems
samir@aurora-systems.com | +1 (206) 555-0199

Subject: Re: Supplier activation: invoice routing, PO terms, and onboarding documents

Hi Samir —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and for attaching the W9 and completed form — I see those and I've uploaded them to our vendor folder. A couple replies inline to your questions:

1) Payment terms: We can approve net-30 for strategic partners on a case-by-case basis. Please include a short note from your AP stating why net-30 is required, and we'll loop in Finance (Aditya) for approval. For now, set expectations that our internal default is net-45 until approved.

2) PO delivery: Please use po@redwood.com — that's our centralized mailbox that ties into our ERP for automatic PO ingestion. We'll add a vendor-specific alias on our side if necessary, but using po@redwood.com ensures POs are created without manual step.

Next steps:
- Samir: please send the MSA (if available) or indicate if Aurora requires a redline review.
- Aurora AP: please confirm if ACH details will be shared via the secure upload link or directly to accounts@aurora-systems.com. If you need the secure portal, reply and we'll open it.
- Aditya: can you confirm whether we can escalate the net-30 request for this account?

Thanks — happy to jump on that quick call if you'd like.

Best,
Olga

Thanks, team — quick finance note here.

Olga: I reviewed the W9 and onboarding form. We're happy to consider net-30 for Aurora given strategic fit (integration pilot + committed monthly usage). To move forward we need:
- A one-paragraph justification from Aurora AP/business owner for net-30 (Samir or accounts can provide).
- Finance will run a credit/terms check (internal).

po@redwood.com is the correct address for PO ingestion. Samir/accounts: please ensure AP sends remittance/ACH information via the secure upload link rather than email for bank details. We'll send the secure portal invitation by end of day.

I will flag DEAL-4821 in our internal tracker and mark as "pending finance approval" for payment terms. Once credit is approved we'll confirm net-30 and issue the initial PO for the onboarding SOW.

Aditya Rao
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | (415) 555-0188
